t: What Language Change Database Is All About
title: What Language Change Database Is All About
description: Language change is the evolution: sound (Grimm's Law: the consonant shift), meaning (the amelioration/pejoration), grammar (the grammaticalization), and the mechanisms (analogy, borrowing, drift). The comparative method: reconstructed (PIE: the proto). The truth: all languages change, always. Document the drift. This database is the complete language change record: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
